why: Definition item: only HasContDiffBump and AdmitsContDiffPartitionsOfUnity are listed, so A = True and both implications are vacuous. The content is B itself, proved outright as B_holds: the project's HasContDiffBump V k (∃ f, ContDiff ℝ k f ∧ f ≠ 0 ∧ IsBounded (support f)) is B's HasCkBumpB V k (∃ f, ContDiff ℝ k f ∧ ∃ x, f x ≠ 0 ∧ tsupport f ⊆ closedBall 0 R for some R). The smoothness clause is literally the same, with k : ℕ∞ cast to WithTop ℕ∞ so that ⊤ means C^∞, not analytic. f ≠ 0 is ∃ x, f x ≠ 0, and a set is bounded iff its closure lies in a closed ball. The project does not need completeness of V; B assumes it, which is harmless.
B_issue: B compares only HasContDiffBump. The second listed definition, AdmitsContDiffPartitionsOfUnity (every open cover of V has a subordinate partition of unity of C^k functions, Mathlib PartitionOfUnity with index type in V's universe), is not part of Definition 5.31 and is not compared.
overlap: 0 shared project theorems (B_holds uses only Mathlib boundedness lemmas).
